Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them.
	Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close.

Features:

- Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells 
- Choose between loose, normal or tight setting
- Loudness boost option

這不是普通的雙搖杆射擊遊戲。這款遊戲強調戰術戰鬥和秘密行動，而不只是開槍射擊，而且還有精彩劇情！ 

戰術戰鬥
發揮環境優勢。透過掩護躲避攻擊。側擊敵人可提高效果，但自己要防止側擊！運用交易的工具創造優勢 — 碎片榴彈、閃光彈、無人機、炮塔、近距離地雷等...

潛行
謹慎選擇靠近方式。有人說沖進槍林彈雨並非良策。分散敵人注意，逐個幹掉敵人。用暗中撂倒和消聲武器暗地裡把敵人幹掉。侵入炮塔，將炮塔對準其主人。將不同的敵方陣營引誘到一起，讓他們互相爭鬥。

裝配與裝備
選擇裝配是戰術的關鍵部分。除了護身服和手榴彈，你還可以帶一個雙手武器和一個單手武器 — 每個人都能選到合適的武器。散彈槍、手槍、突擊步槍、狙擊步槍、十字弓、能量武器、飛斧等。

hk.description:
“An amazingly animated iOS game.” – Time Magazine

“Really can't get enough of Space Marshals.” – Touch Arcade

”Space Marshals just screams “PLAY ME!” – 148 Apps


ABOUT THE GAME
Space Marshals is a Sci-fi Wild West adventure taking place in outer space! This tactical top-down shooter puts you in the shoes of specialist Burton in his hunt for dangerous fugitives after a disastrous prison break.

TACTICAL COMBAT
Use the environment to your advantage. Avoid attacks by taking cover. Flank enemies for extra efficiency, but avoid getting flanked yourself! Use the tools of the trade to gain an edge - frag grenades, flash bangs, distractions, personal shields, proximity mines and more.

STEALTH
Choose your approach with care. Some say running into the fray guns blazing isn’t always the best option. Use distractions to single out opponents. Use disguises and covers to sneak past irrelevant guards. Use silenced weapons to covertly reduce the enemy numbers.

LOAD-OUTS & GEAR
Choosing your load-out is a big part of your tactics. In addition to body armor and grenades you can carry one two-handed and one single-handed weapon in each mission - and there’s something for everyone. Shotguns, handguns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, crossbows, energy weapons, throwing axes and more.

### IMPORTANT ### Please note that iPhone 4 is not supported.

•	Tactical top-down shooter
•	Episodic storyline in three chapters - ALL chapters out now!
•	Gorgeous stylistic HD graphics rendered in Retina resolution (full Retina not supported on iPad 3)
•	Optimized for iOS 8 and Metal graphics!
•	Wide range of weapons and gear
•	Performance based mission rewards
•	Multiple factions to fight with or against – or pitch against each other 
•	Dual stick controls with a set of different options
•	MFi controller support (requires extended layout)
•	iCloud save game support
•	GameCenter achievements

hk.description:
加入数百万玩家，开启这款怪物训练游戏的续集冒险之旅！
在《EvoCreo 2》中，进入充满神秘的怪物世界，捕捉、培养并进化超过300种怪物。体验一个开放世界的RPG，展开一场充满怪物战斗与冒险的游戏旅程。怪物的进化和捕捉是你在这个怪物游戏中的使命，而这片土地上神秘的怪物，等待着你的探索！

揭开迷人的冒险故事
作为一名新兵，在《EvoCreo 2》的角色扮演游戏（RPG）中，加入Shoru警察学院，解开怪物消失背后的谜团。这个怪物游戏不仅仅是捕捉怪物，背后还有更深的阴谋，考验你在怪物战斗中的策略能力。途中，你将完成50多个引人入胜的任务，帮助Shoru的市民，建立联盟并发现隐藏的宝藏。

捕捉与培养超过300只怪物
你喜欢怪物收集游戏吗？在这个开放世界RPG中，组建你的梦想队伍，捕捉、培养、进化各种怪物。游戏中包含了超过300种独特的怪物，每个怪物都有其独特的进化和颜色。体验多样化的怪物捕捉与培养，让你在回合制怪物战斗中制定策略，挑战自我，成为传奇怪物训练师！

探索充满怪物的冒险世界
在《EvoCreo 2》里，你可以享受超过30小时的离线与在线RPG玩法，探索这个充满怪物和隐藏秘密的开放世界。从茂密的森林到神秘的洞穴，再到繁华的城镇，Shoru大陆充满了待解的谜题。在冒险的过程中，挑战不同的怪物，完成任务，解锁隐藏的路径和传奇的宝藏。

掌握深度且策略性的战斗系统
准备好迎接训练师之间的激烈战斗了吗？在这个高度可定制化的RPG游戏中，你可以装备你的怪物，并解锁100多种独特特征来增强它们的能力。训练你的怪物，学习并掌握超过200种技能，随时根据战斗的需要调整技能。通过怪物战斗，管理元素弱点，运用策略技能，成为真正的怪物训练大师！

证明自己，成为终极怪物训练大师
挑战Shoru的最强怪物训练师，在这个付费RPG游戏中崭露头角！参加声名显赫的竞技场，只有最强的怪物训练师才能获得冠军称号。你能在怪物战斗中获得胜利，登上冠军宝座，成为最顶尖的怪物训练大师吗？

主要特点：
- 世界顶级付费角色扮演游戏的续集
- 捕捉、培养、进化超过300只怪物
- 没有怪物等级上限，充满挑战的游戏结局！
- 拓展的开放世界，30小时以上的离线与在线RPG玩法
- 引人入胜的回合制怪物战斗，深度策略元素
- 数百种技能和特征，自由定制你的怪物
- 超过50个充满冒险和奖励的任务
- 离线模式——无需互联网也能畅玩游戏
- 精美的像素艺术，回归经典怪物RPG风格

玩家为何喜爱《EvoCreo 2》：
《EvoCreo 2》是怪物训练游戏和怪物培养RPG的完美结合
物种收集、探索和战斗策略的完美融合
休闲和硬核玩家都能享受这款充满冒险和动作的怪物游戏
今天就加入我们的冒险，开始成为终极怪物训练大师的旅程吧！你能捕捉所有怪物，解开Creo的秘密吗？

hk.description:
《展翅翱翔》是一款屢獲殊榮的鳥類主題策略卡牌遊戲，也是一部鮮活的交互式鳥類百科，清新有趣，輕鬆愉快，適合1-5名玩家。作為鳥類發燒友，你的目標是發現和吸引更多的鳥兒加入你的自然保護區。

《展翅翱翔》（Wingspan）官方授權電子版改編，曾榮獲2019年德國年度桌面遊戲獎，權威桌遊網站BBG家庭類桌遊位列世界第一。

你們是一群鳥類發燒友——研究員、鳥類觀察家、鳥類學家和收藏家——你們一直在尋覓並試圖吸引那些最美麗的鳥類棲息到自己的野生動物保護區來。每一種鳥的加入都會讓你其中一塊棲息地上的鳥類組合變得更為豐富多彩。每一塊棲息地都各自專注於保護區生態搭建的某一重要方面。

本遊戲中，1-5名玩家在有限的回合內構建他們的自然保護區，並與其他玩家競爭。每當新的鳥類加入自然保護區，都會提升保護區在某個方面的能力，諸如鳥類產蛋、抽取新的鳥類卡牌或者收集食物。遊戲中包含170種獨特的鳥類，它們各自擁有對應它們在自然世界中所有的專長或者偏好的技能：例如，老鷹會捕獵，鵜鶘會捕魚，白鵝喜歡群居。

遊戲特色
* 輕鬆愉快的策略類卡牌遊戲，你的目標是發現和吸引最好的鳥兒。
* 同時支持單人和多人模式，最多可5名玩家組隊暢玩。
* 基於屢獲殊榮的引擎構築桌面遊戲，以卡牌為驅動，富有競爭樂趣。
* 數百隻獨特的鳥兒，配有動畫畫面和真實錄音。
* 用多種方式積攢分數，包括鳥兒、獎勵卡牌和回合目標。

hk.description:
Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them.
	Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close.

Features:

- Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells 
- Choose between loose, normal or tight setting
- Loudness boost option

hk.description:
*在購買《冰點之下》之前，請先確認您的裝置是否支援！*

《冰點之下》是《深海迷航》的全新篇章。這款開放世界水下生存遊戲的舞台設於一顆充滿未知海洋的異星行星。
潛入行星 4546B 冰封的極地海域，展開一場全新的零下探險。在墜毀迫降後，你將深入刺骨寒水，尋找關於你姊姊失蹤的真相……
探索前所未見的生態區、奇異生物、全新挑戰與劇情！《冰點之下》擴展了《深海迷航》的宇宙，帶你潛得更深，揭開更多隱藏於深海之下的冒險與謎團。

特色

揭開真相 - 那些曾經來過這裡的外星人是誰？他們為什麼會出現在這顆星球上？你的姊姊究竟發生了什麼事？而當真相大白之後，是否能讓你走出失去她的陰影？

挺過冰寒 - 這片極地的冰凍氣候帶來前所未有的挑戰。製作保暖的寒地裝備、啜飲熱騰騰的咖啡，或靠近熱能百合取暖，讓自己在嚴寒中維持生命。

自造生存之道 - 透過建造基地、蒐集資源與製作裝備，在這嚴酷環境中開創你的生存之路。駕駛雪狐號懸浮車馳騁於冰雪苔原，或乘坐可自由組裝的海蛟號，探索危機四伏卻令人驚嘆的生態區。

探索這顆行星 - 潛入閃耀藍光的扭曲之橋深處、被水晶洞的奇幻景象吸引，進入冰川盆地的冰凍洞穴，或在噴發的地殼裂縫間穿梭，尋找遠古外星遺跡的蹤跡。

遭遇未知生物 - 未知的生命潛伏在每個角落。穿越龐大的泰坦洞洞魚、面對詭譎的暗影利維坦，或與可愛的企鵝相遇。但要時刻保持警覺，這個陌生的世界，並非所有生物都是友善無害。

專為行動裝置精心打造

- 全新操作介面：支援完整觸控的專屬手機 UI
- Game Center 成就系統
- 雲端存檔：支援 iOS 裝置間進度同步

hk.description:
Burgle your way to adventure in the award-winning board game!


A New Adventure Begins!
Clank!, the iconic deck-building board game adventure, challenges daring thieves to sneak into a dragon’s lair, steal one of her precious artifacts, and escape – before you’re roasted to a crisp!
Winning fans and awards around the world, Clank! is one of the most-beloved modern board games, with a wide range of expansions and adaptations for players to enjoy.

How Deep will you Delve?
The deeper you go, the more valuable treasures you’ll find…but the harder it will be to escape! So be quick and be quiet: One false step and – CLANK! Each careless sound risks drawing the dragon’s attention.
You’re competing against your fellow thieves to claim the most valuable prize…but you can only enjoy your loot if you make it out of the depths alive!


Choose Your Path
You’ll need a good pair of boots, a sharp sword, and all your roguish skills to survive in the dungeon. Along the way, you’ll acquire new items, abilities, and allies that will help you achieve victory!
Blending deck-building and exploration, Clank! offers a unique dungeon-delving adventure each time you play."


Many Ways to Play
Learn the ropes in a guided Tutorial, then hone your abilities by collecting Achievements and completing Challenges. Play cross-platform against friends, or compete in exciting new Heists that put you up against players from around the world!

However you choose to enter the dungeon: Good luck!...you’re going to need it!

hk.description:
极具真实感的俯视视角拉力赛体验！
《Rush Rally Origins》是在初代《Rush Rally》经典俯视视角赛车玩法的基础上，结合《Rush Rally 3》广受好评的精美画质与物理引擎打造而成。游戏中包含有 36 条全新且各有特色的赛道，赛道遍布世界各地，每条赛道的时区和天气情况都会有所不同。比赛会在各种不同路况下进行，包括雪地、碎石、泥土、泥浆和柏油路面！


感受极速快感
在 60fps（在支持的设备上可达到 120fps）的极速环境中，驾驶当前空气动力性能最好的赛车车型，这些赛车在《Rush Rally Origins》中都经过了高度调教，极具驾驶乐趣，使玩家可以尽享俯视视角竞赛所带来的极致体验。在通过不同路况时可以时刻感受到抓地力的改变，不同气候条件也会使驾驶体验千差万别。


世界拉力赛
完成一系列冠军拉力赛事，在我们独特的“点对点”竞赛模式下与其他选手同场竞速，亦或是保持专注，在计时赛模式下集中精力提高自己的完赛时间。


勇攀高峰
打破赛道记录，在全球在线排行榜上扬名立万。下载 4 种车型各异的幽灵赛车，与世界最顶尖车手一较高下。


升级赛车
解锁并升级一系列《Rush Rally》经典车型。利用简便的升级系统来为您量身打造每款车型，以期符合您特定驾驶风格的需求。


优化操控性
游戏操控系统经过详细设计，可同时支持触屏和手柄游玩，使游戏具有更多乐趣，而且在不同设备上都可获得一致的操控体验。同时还提供包括缩放、移动和切换功能的按键，您可以按需选择使用。

hk.description:
*在玩《Subnautica》之前，記得先確認你的裝置是否支援！*

《Subnautica》是一款設定在外星海洋星球上的水下冒險遊戲。這個龐大又充滿驚奇和危險的開放世界，等你來探索！

潛入深海、製作裝備、駕駛潛艇，並巧妙應對野生生物，探索茂密的珊瑚礁、火山、洞穴系統等多樣環境——同時努力生存下去。揭開這個充滿生物世界的神祕面紗，這些生物有的親近友好，有的則充滿敵意，且到處散落著過去的線索。

在生存模式下挑戰自我，或切換到自由模式或創意模式，無需擔心水、食物或氧氣的壓力，輕鬆探索這顆海洋星球。

特色
• 求生——在廣大的水下星球迫降後，時間緊迫，必須尋找水和食物，並開發裝備來探索這個世界。
• 探索——在潛入高聳的海帶森林、陽光照耀的高原、生物發光的珊瑚礁和蜿蜒的洞穴系統時，管理你的飢餓、口渴和氧氣供應。
• 搜刮——收集周圍海洋中的資源。深入探險以找到更稀有的資源，讓你能夠製作更先進的物品。
• 製作——建造基地供你避難，製造載具供你駕駛，製作生存工具幫助你在這個水下世界中導航和適應。
• 發現——這個星球發生了什麼事？是什麼導致你墜毀？你能找到方法活著離開這個星球嗎？
• 自訂——在生存模式下挑戰自我，或切換到自由模式或創意模式，無需擔心水、食物或氧氣的壓力，輕鬆探索這顆海洋星球。

精心為行動裝置重新設計

hk.releaseNotes:
The sandworms stir. Covert spies infiltrate the desert planet under deep cover. The spice flows stronger than ever, and beneath it all, everything points to the escalation of war. An insurrection looms on the horizon, and it’s coming your way in Dune: Imperium – Uprising.

Dune: Imperium - Uprising expansion includes the following:
- New board
- New mechanics
- Sandworms
- Contracts
- Spies 
- 9 Leaders
- 69 Imperium Deck cards
- 44 Intrigue cards
- 16 Conflict cards
- A new reserve card - Prepare the Way
- CHOAM Module
- 10 Challenges
- Uprising Skirmish rule and scoring mods
- New Achievements 
Bug Fixes
- Tech Tile count now displays correctly when a stack is emptied 
- Tech Tile tray now automatically opens when you’re being prompted to activate something from it 
- Troop Transports prompt should be more clearly when using it outside of normal turn timings
- You can no longer buy Duncan Idaho too early in the second Tutorial
- Added warning when an acquire ability couldn’t be used due to hitting supply limits
- Shadout Mapes’s reveal ability now accounts for the player gaining troops during the reveal turn
- Fixed timing for winning the Economic Supremacy conflict with a Dreadnought to work better with additional rulesets
- Lisan Al Gaib now reveals for the proper amount of persuasion
- Replacement Eyes no longer requires cards in deck or discard for its ability to be used
- Research track space that trashes an Intrigue card to gain an Intrigue card and draw a card now doesn’t require cards in deck or discard to select
- Helena player can now use Tleilaxu Master to acquire cards set aside via Manipulate
- Acquire icon is now consistent across expansions
- Advancing on the Tleilaxu track to gain an Intrigue card now displays in the proper order
- Improved ability to deploy Dreadnoughts on tablet devices
- Various localization fixes and improvements 

We’re grateful for your continued support in helping shape Dune: Imperium into the best experience possible. If you encounter any issues, unexpected behavior, or have feedback to share, please contact us through the in-game feedback tool or by email at support@direwolfdigital.com.

Thanks for playing Dune: Imperium. Join the struggle. Join the Uprising!
hk.description:
让自己沉浸在《沙丘》的世界中。
在屡获殊荣的棋盘游戏《沙丘：帝国》中，穿梭于地形险恶的厄拉科斯星球，体验策略与阴谋的终极融合！
"在线对战、与人工智能进行本地对战，或与强大的哈葛尔家族对战。
获得成就，展示你作为领袖的实力。
面对十数种挑战，考验你的智慧和狡黠。
在轮换的遭遇战模式中争夺徽章，每场比赛都不尽相同！"
控制香料，就是控制宇宙。
厄拉科斯、沙丘、沙漠星球。在面前的广袤荒原上高举你的旗帜。当立法会各大家族调集军队和间谍时，你将影响谁，又将背叛谁？暴虐的皇帝、神秘的贝尼·杰瑟里特、精明的宇航公会、沙漠深处凶残的弗雷曼人。帝国的力量可以属于你，但战争并不是夺取力量的唯一途径。
《沙丘：帝国》是一款主题鲜明的全新战略游戏，融合了牌组搭建和工人放置的元素，将帝国的命运掌握在你手中。你会寻求政治盟友还是依靠军事力量？靠经济实力还是耍阴谋诡计？让议会席位决定……还是亮出锋利的刀刃？拿好手牌，决定在你手中，帝国正在等待。

hk.description:
在这款备受赞誉的策略桌游中，规划并建设一座科学管理的现代化动物园，为保护项目提供支持。

你将在《Ark Nova》中规划和设计一座科学管理的现代化动物园。并向着“拥有最成功的动物园”的终极目标努力奋斗。你将建造饲养区、容纳动物并支持世界各地的保护项目，专家们和各种独特建筑将帮助你实现这一目标。

《Ark Nova》的核心要素是 255 张以动物、专家、独特饲养区与保护项目为主题的卡牌。每张卡牌都拥有特定能力，你可以利用它们来提高动物园的魅力和科学声望并收集保护点数。每位玩家都有一组行动卡牌，你可以通过使用和升级这些卡牌来实施你的计划。

每位玩家都可以使用一套五张行动卡牌来进行游戏，行动的强度由卡牌当前占据的槽位决定。这些卡牌是：

建造：允许你建造标准/特殊饲养区、贩售亭与休憩亭。

动物：允许你在自己的动物园中容纳动物。

卡牌：允许你获得新动物园卡牌（动物、赞助商以及保护项目卡牌）。

协会：允许你的协会事务员完成不同任务。

赞助商：允许你在自己的动物园中打出一张赞助商卡牌或获得钱币。

《Ark Nova》拥有极高的可玩性和丰富的组件，可提供不同凡响的游戏体验，让玩家无数次体验游戏的乐趣。

高居王座的你將扮演一位仁王（抑或暴君），只需撥動手指，左揮右劃，就能下達決策來統禦你的國家。熬過那無盡詛咒般的歲月，應對你的臣下、你的軍隊、你的子民以及你的敵人那些源源不斷的要求，權衡各大勢力來維持自己的權力。你可要當心了：你的每次決策都可能造成重大的影響，招致不幸的命運洪流，為你的王位和家族招來危機，導致王位甚至生命被褫奪。

飄忽不定的王國命運：每年發生的隨機事件會根據你的選擇對宗教，民生，軍事和財政四個方面造成影響。謹小慎微的決策和富有遠見的規劃是統治長青的奧秘所在，然而，難以預料的突然事件或者可憐的黴運都可能輕易動搖你看似牢不可破的權力。

《鏽湖旅館》是一款獨特的益智遊戲，它離奇古怪的場景設置靈感源自於大衛‧林區的電視連續劇《雙峰》。

在一所心理健康中心裡醒來的Robert Hill罹患了嚴重的失憶症。他需要每天遵循嚴格的作息時間，通過探索自己的夢境來找回記憶。

The White Door是一款由方塊逃脫和鏽湖系列遊戲的開發者製作的指向與點擊式冒險遊戲。

關鍵特徵:

■ 操作簡單
容易上手，但一旦玩起來就停不下來

■ 獨特的故事線
每天恪守嚴格的作息時間，探尋夢境，並找回記憶。多樣的謎題妙趣橫生，讓你意猶未盡。

■ 前所未有的分屏式體驗
你將有機會探尋Robert Hill在心理健康中心裡的經歷，而全新的分屏模式也會帶給你一個嶄新的體驗。

■ 極具代入感的氛圍
精神衛生中心每天的氣氛變幻莫測，懸念叢生，讓你沉浸在詭譎疊起的情節裡不能自拔。

■ 身臨其境般的音效
由Victor Butzelaar製作的主題曲和音效讓你身臨其境。

■ 特別成就
The White Door會留下很多尚待揭曉的懸念。

hk.description:
Play the digital adaptation of the beloved tabletop board game. Root is a game of adventure and war where 2 to 4 players battle for control of a vast wilderness.

The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Though some may sympathize with the Alliance’s hopes and dreams, these wanderers are old enough to remember the great birds of prey who once controlled the woods.

Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright.

The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

hk.description:
備註：The Past Within 是一款雙人合作遊戲。雙方玩家皆須於各自的設備上備有此款遊戲（手機、平板或電腦）以及互相溝通的管道。與夥伴一起遊玩，或到官方Discord來找尋志同道合的夥伴吧！

自己一人是無法探索未來與過去的！快找朋友一同拼湊線索來解開Albert Vanderboom的謎團。和朋友互相交流自己所看見的世界，來幫助彼此解開謎題、探索不同的時空！

The Past Within 是首款雙人合作的 點擊式冒險遊戲，架構於Rusty Lake的神祕世界中。

特色

▪ 達到雙人合作的經驗 
與朋友一起遊玩，一位探索過去，一位開發未來。一同合作來解開謎團，幫助Rose啟動她父親的計畫！
▪ 兩個世界 - 兩種視角 
兩位玩家將會以不同的層面去探索各自的世界。既有2D也有3D呈現 - 一種從未存在於 Rusty Lake 世界觀的遊玩方式！
▪ 跨平台遊玩
只要能與夥伴互相溝通，你們即可於各自偏好的平台一同來進行遊戲，支援的系統有：Mac、PC以及Nintendo Switch！
▪ 遊玩時長＆可重複遊玩

這不是普通的雙搖杆射擊遊戲。這款遊戲強調戰術戰鬥和秘密行動，而不只是開槍射擊，而且還有精彩劇情！ 

戰術戰鬥
發揮環境優勢。透過掩護躲避攻擊。側擊敵人可提高效果，但自己要防止側擊！運用交易的工具創造優勢 — 碎片榴彈、閃光彈、無人機、炮塔、近距離地雷等...

潛行
謹慎選擇靠近方式。有人說沖進槍林彈雨並非良策。分散敵人注意，逐個幹掉敵人。用暗中撂倒和消聲武器暗地裡把敵人幹掉。侵入炮塔，將炮塔對準其主人。將不同的敵方陣營引誘到一起，讓他們互相爭鬥。

裝配與裝備

mo.description:
“An amazingly animated iOS game.” – Time Magazine

“Really can't get enough of Space Marshals.” – Touch Arcade

”Space Marshals just screams “PLAY ME!” – 148 Apps


ABOUT THE GAME
Space Marshals is a Sci-fi Wild West adventure taking place in outer space! This tactical top-down shooter puts you in the shoes of specialist Burton in his hunt for dangerous fugitives after a disastrous prison break.

TACTICAL COMBAT
Use the environment to your advantage. Avoid attacks by taking cover. Flank enemies for extra efficiency, but avoid getting flanked yourself! Use the tools of the trade to gain an edge - frag grenades, flash bangs, distractions, personal shields, proximity mines and more.

STEALTH
Choose your approach with care. Some say running into the fray guns blazing isn’t always the best option. Use distractions to single out opponents. Use disguises and covers to sneak past irrelevant guards. Use silenced weapons to covertly reduce the enemy numbers.

LOAD-OUTS & GEAR
Choosing your load-out is a big part of your tactics. In addition to body armor and grenades you can carry one two-handed and one single-handed weapon in each mission - and there’s something for everyone. Shotguns, handguns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, crossbows, energy weapons, throwing axes and more.

### IMPORTANT ### Please note that iPhone 4 is not supported.

•	Tactical top-down shooter

歡迎遊玩《Iron Marines: Invasion!》

暢玩刺激新世界中的獨特關卡任務和特殊行動，每個世界都有自己的特別地形、玩法、敵人和條件。學習如何一一擊敗他們！

獻給所有喜歡單機即時戰略遊戲和戰略遊戲的《Iron Marines》和科幻動作遊戲粉絲。藉由帶領自己的軍隊執行刺激驚奇的任務來實現你的戰術專家使命。

入侵已經近在眉睫！
率領銀河各地最勇猛的戰鬥部隊。與聯邦最強大的海軍陸戰隊並肩作戰！

成為銀河系最大謎團的專家！

- 一整個銀河等你探索。
- 超過 25 個戰役任務將帶你前往許多最不可思議的世界。規劃緊密的戰略遊戲計畫，有大量的星球等你探索和防衛！

- 超過 20 項成就，讓你證明你成為了一名多高明的即時戰略專家！

選擇您的難度模式以獲得最佳的即時戰略遊戲體驗：休閒、普通或老手。而且，如果你認為玩遍了整個銀河……還有不可能模式可供選擇，這僅適用於精英玩家，可離線使用！

在每日挑戰中證明自己並收集驚人的獎勵。

離線玩即時戰略遊戲：探索令人難以置信的世界，隨時隨地享受精彩的即時戰略體驗。

加入数百万玩家，开启这款怪物训练游戏的续集冒险之旅！
在《EvoCreo 2》中，进入充满神秘的怪物世界，捕捉、培养并进化超过300种怪物。体验一个开放世界的RPG，展开一场充满怪物战斗与冒险的游戏旅程。怪物的进化和捕捉是你在这个怪物游戏中的使命，而这片土地上神秘的怪物，等待着你的探索！

揭开迷人的冒险故事
作为一名新兵，在《EvoCreo 2》的角色扮演游戏（RPG）中，加入Shoru警察学院，解开怪物消失背后的谜团。这个怪物游戏不仅仅是捕捉怪物，背后还有更深的阴谋，考验你在怪物战斗中的策略能力。途中，你将完成50多个引人入胜的任务，帮助Shoru的市民，建立联盟并发现隐藏的宝藏。

捕捉与培养超过300只怪物
你喜欢怪物收集游戏吗？在这个开放世界RPG中，组建你的梦想队伍，捕捉、培养、进化各种怪物。游戏中包含了超过300种独特的怪物，每个怪物都有其独特的进化和颜色。体验多样化的怪物捕捉与培养，让你在回合制怪物战斗中制定策略，挑战自我，成为传奇怪物训练师！

探索充满怪物的冒险世界
在《EvoCreo 2》里，你可以享受超过30小时的离线与在线RPG玩法，探索这个充满怪物和隐藏秘密的开放世界。从茂密的森林到神秘的洞穴，再到繁华的城镇，Shoru大陆充满了待解的谜题。在冒险的过程中，挑战不同的怪物，完成任务，解锁隐藏的路径和传奇的宝藏。

掌握深度且策略性的战斗系统
准备好迎接训练师之间的激烈战斗了吗？在这个高度可定制化的RPG游戏中，你可以装备你的怪物，并解锁100多种独特特征来增强它们的能力。训练你的怪物，学习并掌握超过200种技能，随时根据战斗的需要调整技能。通过怪物战斗，管理元素弱点，运用策略技能，成为真正的怪物训练大师！

证明自己，成为终极怪物训练大师
挑战Shoru的最强怪物训练师，在这个付费RPG游戏中崭露头角！参加声名显赫的竞技场，只有最强的怪物训练师才能获得冠军称号。你能在怪物战斗中获得胜利，登上冠军宝座，成为最顶尖的怪物训练大师吗？

- 世界顶级付费角色扮演游戏的续集

- 引人入胜的回合制怪物战斗，深度策略元素

- 超过50个充满冒险和奖励的任务
- 离线模式——无需互联网也能畅玩游戏
- 精美的像素艺术，回归经典怪物RPG风格

玩家为何喜爱《EvoCreo 2》：
《EvoCreo 2》是怪物训练游戏和怪物培养RPG的完美结合
物种收集、探索和战斗策略的完美融合
休闲和硬核玩家都能享受这款充满冒险和动作的怪物游戏
今天就加入我们的冒险，开始成为终极怪物训练大师的旅程吧！你能捕捉所有怪物，解开Creo的秘密吗？

mo.description:
《展翅翱翔》是一款屢獲殊榮的鳥類主題策略卡牌遊戲，也是一部鮮活的交互式鳥類百科，清新有趣，輕鬆愉快，適合1-5名玩家。作為鳥類發燒友，你的目標是發現和吸引更多的鳥兒加入你的自然保護區。

《展翅翱翔》（Wingspan）官方授權電子版改編，曾榮獲2019年德國年度桌面遊戲獎，權威桌遊網站BBG家庭類桌遊位列世界第一。

你們是一群鳥類發燒友——研究員、鳥類觀察家、鳥類學家和收藏家——你們一直在尋覓並試圖吸引那些最美麗的鳥類棲息到自己的野生動物保護區來。每一種鳥的加入都會讓你其中一塊棲息地上的鳥類組合變得更為豐富多彩。每一塊棲息地都各自專注於保護區生態搭建的某一重要方面。

本遊戲中，1-5名玩家在有限的回合內構建他們的自然保護區，並與其他玩家競爭。每當新的鳥類加入自然保護區，都會提升保護區在某個方面的能力，諸如鳥類產蛋、抽取新的鳥類卡牌或者收集食物。遊戲中包含170種獨特的鳥類，它們各自擁有對應它們在自然世界中所有的專長或者偏好的技能：例如，老鷹會捕獵，鵜鶘會捕魚，白鵝喜歡群居。

遊戲特色
* 輕鬆愉快的策略類卡牌遊戲，你的目標是發現和吸引最好的鳥兒。
* 同時支持單人和多人模式，最多可5名玩家組隊暢玩。
* 基於屢獲殊榮的引擎構築桌面遊戲，以卡牌為驅動，富有競爭樂趣。
* 數百隻獨特的鳥兒，配有動畫畫面和真實錄音。
* 用多種方式積攢分數，包括鳥兒、獎勵卡牌和回合目標。

mo.description:
Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them.
	Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close.

Features:

- Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells 
- Choose between loose, normal or tight setting
- Loudness boost option

*在購買《冰點之下》之前，請先確認您的裝置是否支援！*

《冰點之下》是《深海迷航》的全新篇章。這款開放世界水下生存遊戲的舞台設於一顆充滿未知海洋的異星行星。
潛入行星 4546B 冰封的極地海域，展開一場全新的零下探險。在墜毀迫降後，你將深入刺骨寒水，尋找關於你姊姊失蹤的真相……
探索前所未見的生態區、奇異生物、全新挑戰與劇情！《冰點之下》擴展了《深海迷航》的宇宙，帶你潛得更深，揭開更多隱藏於深海之下的冒險與謎團。

特色

揭開真相 - 那些曾經來過這裡的外星人是誰？他們為什麼會出現在這顆星球上？你的姊姊究竟發生了什麼事？而當真相大白之後，是否能讓你走出失去她的陰影？

挺過冰寒 - 這片極地的冰凍氣候帶來前所未有的挑戰。製作保暖的寒地裝備、啜飲熱騰騰的咖啡，或靠近熱能百合取暖，讓自己在嚴寒中維持生命。

自造生存之道 - 透過建造基地、蒐集資源與製作裝備，在這嚴酷環境中開創你的生存之路。駕駛雪狐號懸浮車馳騁於冰雪苔原，或乘坐可自由組裝的海蛟號，探索危機四伏卻令人驚嘆的生態區。

探索這顆行星 - 潛入閃耀藍光的扭曲之橋深處、被水晶洞的奇幻景象吸引，進入冰川盆地的冰凍洞穴，或在噴發的地殼裂縫間穿梭，尋找遠古外星遺跡的蹤跡。

遭遇未知生物 - 未知的生命潛伏在每個角落。穿越龐大的泰坦洞洞魚、面對詭譎的暗影利維坦，或與可愛的企鵝相遇。但要時刻保持警覺，這個陌生的世界，並非所有生物都是友善無害。

Burgle your way to adventure in the award-winning board game!


A New Adventure Begins!
Clank!, the iconic deck-building board game adventure, challenges daring thieves to sneak into a dragon’s lair, steal one of her precious artifacts, and escape – before you’re roasted to a crisp!
Winning fans and awards around the world, Clank! is one of the most-beloved modern board games, with a wide range of expansions and adaptations for players to enjoy.

How Deep will you Delve?
The deeper you go, the more valuable treasures you’ll find…but the harder it will be to escape! So be quick and be quiet: One false step and – CLANK! Each careless sound risks drawing the dragon’s attention.
You’re competing against your fellow thieves to claim the most valuable prize…but you can only enjoy your loot if you make it out of the depths alive!


Choose Your Path
You’ll need a good pair of boots, a sharp sword, and all your roguish skills to survive in the dungeon. Along the way, you’ll acquire new items, abilities, and allies that will help you achieve victory!
Blending deck-building and exploration, Clank! offers a unique dungeon-delving adventure each time you play."


Many Ways to Play
Learn the ropes in a guided Tutorial, then hone your abilities by collecting Achievements and completing Challenges. Play cross-platform against friends, or compete in exciting new Heists that put you up against players from around the world!

However you choose to enter the dungeon: Good luck!...you’re going to need it!

感受极速快感
在 60fps（在支持的设备上可达到 120fps）的极速环境中，驾驶当前空气动力性能最好的赛车车型，这些赛车在《Rush Rally Origins》中都经过了高度调教，极具驾驶乐趣，使玩家可以尽享俯视视角竞赛所带来的极致体验。在通过不同路况时可以时刻感受到抓地力的改变，不同气候条件也会使驾驶体验千差万别。


世界拉力赛
完成一系列冠军拉力赛事，在我们独特的“点对点”竞赛模式下与其他选手同场竞速，亦或是保持专注，在计时赛模式下集中精力提高自己的完赛时间。

升级赛车
解锁并升级一系列《Rush Rally》经典车型。利用简便的升级系统来为您量身打造每款车型，以期符合您特定驾驶风格的需求。


优化操控性
游戏操控系统经过详细设计，可同时支持触屏和手柄游玩，使游戏具有更多乐趣，而且在不同设备上都可获得一致的操控体验。同时还提供包括缩放、移动和切换功能的按键，您可以按需选择使用。

在屡获殊荣的棋盘游戏《沙丘：帝国》中，穿梭于地形险恶的厄拉科斯星球，体验策略与阴谋的终极融合！
"在线对战、与人工智能进行本地对战，或与强大的哈葛尔家族对战。
获得成就，展示你作为领袖的实力。
面对十数种挑战，考验你的智慧和狡黠。
在轮换的遭遇战模式中争夺徽章，每场比赛都不尽相同！"
控制香料，就是控制宇宙。
厄拉科斯、沙丘、沙漠星球。在面前的广袤荒原上高举你的旗帜。当立法会各大家族调集军队和间谍时，你将影响谁，又将背叛谁？暴虐的皇帝、神秘的贝尼·杰瑟里特、精明的宇航公会、沙漠深处凶残的弗雷曼人。帝国的力量可以属于你，但战争并不是夺取力量的唯一途径。

mo.description:
在这款备受赞誉的策略桌游中，规划并建设一座科学管理的现代化动物园，为保护项目提供支持。

你将在《Ark Nova》中规划和设计一座科学管理的现代化动物园。并向着“拥有最成功的动物园”的终极目标努力奋斗。你将建造饲养区、容纳动物并支持世界各地的保护项目，专家们和各种独特建筑将帮助你实现这一目标。

《Ark Nova》的核心要素是 255 张以动物、专家、独特饲养区与保护项目为主题的卡牌。每张卡牌都拥有特定能力，你可以利用它们来提高动物园的魅力和科学声望并收集保护点数。每位玩家都有一组行动卡牌，你可以通过使用和升级这些卡牌来实施你的计划。

每位玩家都可以使用一套五张行动卡牌来进行游戏，行动的强度由卡牌当前占据的槽位决定。这些卡牌是：

建造：允许你建造标准/特殊饲养区、贩售亭与休憩亭。

动物：允许你在自己的动物园中容纳动物。

卡牌：允许你获得新动物园卡牌（动物、赞助商以及保护项目卡牌）。

协会：允许你的协会事务员完成不同任务。

赞助商：允许你在自己的动物园中打出一张赞助商卡牌或获得钱币。

《Ark Nova》拥有极高的可玩性和丰富的组件，可提供不同凡响的游戏体验，让玩家无数次体验游戏的乐趣。

高居王座的你將扮演一位仁王（抑或暴君），只需撥動手指，左揮右劃，就能下達決策來統禦你的國家。熬過那無盡詛咒般的歲月，應對你的臣下、你的軍隊、你的子民以及你的敵人那些源源不斷的要求，權衡各大勢力來維持自己的權力。你可要當心了：你的每次決策都可能造成重大的影響，招致不幸的命運洪流，為你的王位和家族招來危機，導致王位甚至生命被褫奪。

飄忽不定的王國命運：每年發生的隨機事件會根據你的選擇對宗教，民生，軍事和財政四個方面造成影響。謹小慎微的決策和富有遠見的規劃是統治長青的奧秘所在，然而，難以預料的突然事件或者可憐的黴運都可能輕易動搖你看似牢不可破的權力。

《鏽湖旅館》是一款獨特的益智遊戲，它離奇古怪的場景設置靈感源自於大衛‧林區的電視連續劇《雙峰》。

在一所心理健康中心裡醒來的Robert Hill罹患了嚴重的失憶症。他需要每天遵循嚴格的作息時間，通過探索自己的夢境來找回記憶。

關鍵特徵:

每天恪守嚴格的作息時間，探尋夢境，並找回記憶。多樣的謎題妙趣橫生，讓你意猶未盡。

你將有機會探尋Robert Hill在心理健康中心裡的經歷，而全新的分屏模式也會帶給你一個嶄新的體驗。

精神衛生中心每天的氣氛變幻莫測，懸念叢生，讓你沉浸在詭譎疊起的情節裡不能自拔。

由Victor Butzelaar製作的主題曲和音效讓你身臨其境。

The White Door會留下很多尚待揭曉的懸念。

mo.description:
Play the digital adaptation of the beloved tabletop board game. Root is a game of adventure and war where 2 to 4 players battle for control of a vast wilderness.

The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Though some may sympathize with the Alliance’s hopes and dreams, these wanderers are old enough to remember the great birds of prey who once controlled the woods.

Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright.

The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

mo.description:
備註：The Past Within 是一款雙人合作遊戲。雙方玩家皆須於各自的設備上備有此款遊戲（手機、平板或電腦）以及互相溝通的管道。與夥伴一起遊玩，或到官方Discord來找尋志同道合的夥伴吧！

自己一人是無法探索未來與過去的！快找朋友一同拼湊線索來解開Albert Vanderboom的謎團。和朋友互相交流自己所看見的世界，來幫助彼此解開謎題、探索不同的時空！

The Past Within 是首款雙人合作的 點擊式冒險遊戲，架構於Rusty Lake的神祕世界中。

特色

▪ 達到雙人合作的經驗 
與朋友一起遊玩，一位探索過去，一位開發未來。一同合作來解開謎團，幫助Rose啟動她父親的計畫！
▪ 兩個世界 - 兩種視角 
兩位玩家將會以不同的層面去探索各自的世界。既有2D也有3D呈現 - 一種從未存在於 Rusty Lake 世界觀的遊玩方式！
▪ 跨平台遊玩
只要能與夥伴互相溝通，你們即可於各自偏好的平台一同來進行遊戲，支援的系統有：Mac、PC以及Nintendo Switch！
▪ 遊玩時長＆可重複遊玩
此遊戲含有兩個篇章，平均遊玩時間約為２小時。若想全方面體驗此款遊戲，我們非常建議可以再以不同的視角遊玩一次。 此外！可透過重複遊玩來使用嶄新的視角去解開謎團。

tw.description:
《太空刑警 2》繼續講述發生在外太空的科幻西部大冒險。在這款戰術性分級制射擊遊戲中，你扮演專家 Burton，與銀河系的犯罪份子展開鬥爭。 

這不是普通的雙搖杆射擊遊戲。這款遊戲強調戰術戰鬥和秘密行動，而不只是開槍射擊，而且還有精彩劇情！ 

戰術戰鬥
發揮環境優勢。透過掩護躲避攻擊。側擊敵人可提高效果，但自己要防止側擊！運用交易的工具創造優勢 — 碎片榴彈、閃光彈、無人機、炮塔、近距離地雷等...

潛行
謹慎選擇靠近方式。有人說沖進槍林彈雨並非良策。分散敵人注意，逐個幹掉敵人。用暗中撂倒和消聲武器暗地裡把敵人幹掉。侵入炮塔，將炮塔對準其主人。將不同的敵方陣營引誘到一起，讓他們互相爭鬥。

裝配與裝備
選擇裝配是戰術的關鍵部分。除了護身服和手榴彈，你還可以帶一個雙手武器和一個單手武器 — 每個人都能選到合適的武器。散彈槍、手槍、突擊步槍、狙擊步槍、十字弓、能量武器、飛斧等。

tw.description:
“An amazingly animated iOS game.” – Time Magazine

“Really can't get enough of Space Marshals.” – Touch Arcade

”Space Marshals just screams “PLAY ME!” – 148 Apps


ABOUT THE GAME
Space Marshals is a Sci-fi Wild West adventure taking place in outer space! This tactical top-down shooter puts you in the shoes of specialist Burton in his hunt for dangerous fugitives after a disastrous prison break.

TACTICAL COMBAT
Use the environment to your advantage. Avoid attacks by taking cover. Flank enemies for extra efficiency, but avoid getting flanked yourself! Use the tools of the trade to gain an edge - frag grenades, flash bangs, distractions, personal shields, proximity mines and more.

STEALTH
Choose your approach with care. Some say running into the fray guns blazing isn’t always the best option. Use distractions to single out opponents. Use disguises and covers to sneak past irrelevant guards. Use silenced weapons to covertly reduce the enemy numbers.

LOAD-OUTS & GEAR
Choosing your load-out is a big part of your tactics. In addition to body armor and grenades you can carry one two-handed and one single-handed weapon in each mission - and there’s something for everyone. Shotguns, handguns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, crossbows, energy weapons, throwing axes and more.

### IMPORTANT ### Please note that iPhone 4 is not supported.

•	Tactical top-down shooter
•	Episodic storyline in three chapters - ALL chapters out now!
•	Gorgeous stylistic HD graphics rendered in Retina resolution (full Retina not supported on iPad 3)
•	Optimized for iOS 8 and Metal graphics!
•	Wide range of weapons and gear
•	Performance based mission rewards
•	Multiple factions to fight with or against – or pitch against each other 
•	Dual stick controls with a set of different options
•	MFi controller support (requires extended layout)
•	iCloud save game support
•	GameCenter achievements

揭开迷人的冒险故事
作为一名新兵，在《EvoCreo 2》的角色扮演游戏（RPG）中，加入Shoru警察学院，解开怪物消失背后的谜团。这个怪物游戏不仅仅是捕捉怪物，背后还有更深的阴谋，考验你在怪物战斗中的策略能力。途中，你将完成50多个引人入胜的任务，帮助Shoru的市民，建立联盟并发现隐藏的宝藏。

捕捉与培养超过300只怪物
你喜欢怪物收集游戏吗？在这个开放世界RPG中，组建你的梦想队伍，捕捉、培养、进化各种怪物。游戏中包含了超过300种独特的怪物，每个怪物都有其独特的进化和颜色。体验多样化的怪物捕捉与培养，让你在回合制怪物战斗中制定策略，挑战自我，成为传奇怪物训练师！

探索充满怪物的冒险世界

《EvoCreo 2》是怪物训练游戏和怪物培养RPG的完美结合
物种收集、探索和战斗策略的完美融合

* 用多種方式積攢分數，包括鳥兒、獎勵卡牌和回合目標。

tw.description:
Wipr blocks ads, popups, trackers, cookie warnings, and other nasty things that make the web slow and ugly.

Websites in Safari will look clean, load fast, and stop invisibly tracking you. You’ll notice significant improvements to your battery life and data usage. Setup is a snap.

The Filtr add-on extends Wipr’s blocking to all apps on your devices. It acts at the network level, but unlike a VPN, it can access none of your data, and can be used in conjunction with VPNs, iCloud Private Relay, and custom DNS.

Wipr’s blocklist is updated twice a week automatically, and has enhanced versions for the following languages: Bosnian, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Montenegrin, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Spanish, Thai, and Vietnamese.

Wipr is a universal app: install it on all your devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro) with a single purchase. It’s fully accessible with VoiceOver, Voice Control, and more. Dark, Tinted, and Clear icon variants are included. Family Sharing is supported.

Because it’s developed by a single independent developer and 100% funded by its users, Wipr only answers to you: no one can pay to have their ads unblocked, and there are no “acceptable ads”.

This app was made with love and patience. I hope you’ll enjoy using it as much as I enjoyed designing and building it.

tw.description:
Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them.
	Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close.

Features:

- Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells 
- Choose between loose, normal or tight setting
- Loudness boost option

tw.description:
*在購買《冰點之下》之前，請先確認您的裝置是否支援！*

《冰點之下》是《深海迷航》的全新篇章。這款開放世界水下生存遊戲的舞台設於一顆充滿未知海洋的異星行星。
潛入行星 4546B 冰封的極地海域，展開一場全新的零下探險。在墜毀迫降後，你將深入刺骨寒水，尋找關於你姊姊失蹤的真相……
探索前所未見的生態區、奇異生物、全新挑戰與劇情！《冰點之下》擴展了《深海迷航》的宇宙，帶你潛得更深，揭開更多隱藏於深海之下的冒險與謎團。

特色

揭開真相 - 那些曾經來過這裡的外星人是誰？他們為什麼會出現在這顆星球上？你的姊姊究竟發生了什麼事？而當真相大白之後，是否能讓你走出失去她的陰影？

挺過冰寒 - 這片極地的冰凍氣候帶來前所未有的挑戰。製作保暖的寒地裝備、啜飲熱騰騰的咖啡，或靠近熱能百合取暖，讓自己在嚴寒中維持生命。

自造生存之道 - 透過建造基地、蒐集資源與製作裝備，在這嚴酷環境中開創你的生存之路。駕駛雪狐號懸浮車馳騁於冰雪苔原，或乘坐可自由組裝的海蛟號，探索危機四伏卻令人驚嘆的生態區。

探索這顆行星 - 潛入閃耀藍光的扭曲之橋深處、被水晶洞的奇幻景象吸引，進入冰川盆地的冰凍洞穴，或在噴發的地殼裂縫間穿梭，尋找遠古外星遺跡的蹤跡。

遭遇未知生物 - 未知的生命潛伏在每個角落。穿越龐大的泰坦洞洞魚、面對詭譎的暗影利維坦，或與可愛的企鵝相遇。但要時刻保持警覺，這個陌生的世界，並非所有生物都是友善無害。

專為行動裝置精心打造

- 全新操作介面：支援完整觸控的專屬手機 UI
- Game Center 成就系統

tw.description:
Burgle your way to adventure in the award-winning board game!


A New Adventure Begins!
Clank!, the iconic deck-building board game adventure, challenges daring thieves to sneak into a dragon’s lair, steal one of her precious artifacts, and escape – before you’re roasted to a crisp!
Winning fans and awards around the world, Clank! is one of the most-beloved modern board games, with a wide range of expansions and adaptations for players to enjoy.

How Deep will you Delve?
The deeper you go, the more valuable treasures you’ll find…but the harder it will be to escape! So be quick and be quiet: One false step and – CLANK! Each careless sound risks drawing the dragon’s attention.
You’re competing against your fellow thieves to claim the most valuable prize…but you can only enjoy your loot if you make it out of the depths alive!


Choose Your Path
You’ll need a good pair of boots, a sharp sword, and all your roguish skills to survive in the dungeon. Along the way, you’ll acquire new items, abilities, and allies that will help you achieve victory!
Blending deck-building and exploration, Clank! offers a unique dungeon-delving adventure each time you play."


Many Ways to Play
Learn the ropes in a guided Tutorial, then hone your abilities by collecting Achievements and completing Challenges. Play cross-platform against friends, or compete in exciting new Heists that put you up against players from around the world!

However you choose to enter the dungeon: Good luck!...you’re going to need it!

tw.description:
极具真实感的俯视视角拉力赛体验！
《Rush Rally Origins》是在初代《Rush Rally》经典俯视视角赛车玩法的基础上，结合《Rush Rally 3》广受好评的精美画质与物理引擎打造而成。游戏中包含有 36 条全新且各有特色的赛道，赛道遍布世界各地，每条赛道的时区和天气情况都会有所不同。比赛会在各种不同路况下进行，包括雪地、碎石、泥土、泥浆和柏油路面！


感受极速快感
在 60fps（在支持的设备上可达到 120fps）的极速环境中，驾驶当前空气动力性能最好的赛车车型，这些赛车在《Rush Rally Origins》中都经过了高度调教，极具驾驶乐趣，使玩家可以尽享俯视视角竞赛所带来的极致体验。在通过不同路况时可以时刻感受到抓地力的改变，不同气候条件也会使驾驶体验千差万别。


世界拉力赛
完成一系列冠军拉力赛事，在我们独特的“点对点”竞赛模式下与其他选手同场竞速，亦或是保持专注，在计时赛模式下集中精力提高自己的完赛时间。


勇攀高峰
打破赛道记录，在全球在线排行榜上扬名立万。下载 4 种车型各异的幽灵赛车，与世界最顶尖车手一较高下。


升级赛车
解锁并升级一系列《Rush Rally》经典车型。利用简便的升级系统来为您量身打造每款车型，以期符合您特定驾驶风格的需求。


优化操控性
游戏操控系统经过详细设计，可同时支持触屏和手柄游玩，使游戏具有更多乐趣，而且在不同设备上都可获得一致的操控体验。同时还提供包括缩放、移动和切换功能的按键，您可以按需选择使用。

*在玩《Subnautica》之前，記得先確認你的裝置是否支援！*

《Subnautica》是一款設定在外星海洋星球上的水下冒險遊戲。這個龐大又充滿驚奇和危險的開放世界，等你來探索！

潛入深海、製作裝備、駕駛潛艇，並巧妙應對野生生物，探索茂密的珊瑚礁、火山、洞穴系統等多樣環境——同時努力生存下去。揭開這個充滿生物世界的神祕面紗，這些生物有的親近友好，有的則充滿敵意，且到處散落著過去的線索。

在生存模式下挑戰自我，或切換到自由模式或創意模式，無需擔心水、食物或氧氣的壓力，輕鬆探索這顆海洋星球。

特色
• 求生——在廣大的水下星球迫降後，時間緊迫，必須尋找水和食物，並開發裝備來探索這個世界。
• 探索——在潛入高聳的海帶森林、陽光照耀的高原、生物發光的珊瑚礁和蜿蜒的洞穴系統時，管理你的飢餓、口渴和氧氣供應。
• 搜刮——收集周圍海洋中的資源。深入探險以找到更稀有的資源，讓你能夠製作更先進的物品。
• 製作——建造基地供你避難，製造載具供你駕駛，製作生存工具幫助你在這個水下世界中導航和適應。
• 發現——這個星球發生了什麼事？是什麼導致你墜毀？你能找到方法活著離開這個星球嗎？

tw.releaseNotes:
The sandworms stir. Covert spies infiltrate the desert planet under deep cover. The spice flows stronger than ever, and beneath it all, everything points to the escalation of war. An insurrection looms on the horizon, and it’s coming your way in Dune: Imperium – Uprising.

Dune: Imperium - Uprising expansion includes the following:
- New board
- New mechanics
- Sandworms
- Contracts
- Spies 
- 9 Leaders
- 69 Imperium Deck cards
- 44 Intrigue cards
- 16 Conflict cards
- A new reserve card - Prepare the Way
- CHOAM Module
- 10 Challenges
- Uprising Skirmish rule and scoring mods
- New Achievements 
Bug Fixes
- Tech Tile count now displays correctly when a stack is emptied 
- Tech Tile tray now automatically opens when you’re being prompted to activate something from it 
- Troop Transports prompt should be more clearly when using it outside of normal turn timings
- You can no longer buy Duncan Idaho too early in the second Tutorial
- Added warning when an acquire ability couldn’t be used due to hitting supply limits
- Shadout Mapes’s reveal ability now accounts for the player gaining troops during the reveal turn
- Fixed timing for winning the Economic Supremacy conflict with a Dreadnought to work better with additional rulesets
- Lisan Al Gaib now reveals for the proper amount of persuasion
- Replacement Eyes no longer requires cards in deck or discard for its ability to be used
- Research track space that trashes an Intrigue card to gain an Intrigue card and draw a card now doesn’t require cards in deck or discard to select
- Helena player can now use Tleilaxu Master to acquire cards set aside via Manipulate
- Acquire icon is now consistent across expansions
- Advancing on the Tleilaxu track to gain an Intrigue card now displays in the proper order
- Improved ability to deploy Dreadnoughts on tablet devices
- Various localization fixes and improvements 

We’re grateful for your continued support in helping shape Dune: Imperium into the best experience possible. If you encounter any issues, unexpected behavior, or have feedback to share, please contact us through the in-game feedback tool or by email at support@direwolfdigital.com.

Thanks for playing Dune: Imperium. Join the struggle. Join the Uprising!
tw.description:
让自己沉浸在《沙丘》的世界中。
在屡获殊荣的棋盘游戏《沙丘：帝国》中，穿梭于地形险恶的厄拉科斯星球，体验策略与阴谋的终极融合！
"在线对战、与人工智能进行本地对战，或与强大的哈葛尔家族对战。
获得成就，展示你作为领袖的实力。
面对十数种挑战，考验你的智慧和狡黠。
在轮换的遭遇战模式中争夺徽章，每场比赛都不尽相同！"
控制香料，就是控制宇宙。
厄拉科斯、沙丘、沙漠星球。在面前的广袤荒原上高举你的旗帜。当立法会各大家族调集军队和间谍时，你将影响谁，又将背叛谁？暴虐的皇帝、神秘的贝尼·杰瑟里特、精明的宇航公会、沙漠深处凶残的弗雷曼人。帝国的力量可以属于你，但战争并不是夺取力量的唯一途径。
《沙丘：帝国》是一款主题鲜明的全新战略游戏，融合了牌组搭建和工人放置的元素，将帝国的命运掌握在你手中。你会寻求政治盟友还是依靠军事力量？靠经济实力还是耍阴谋诡计？让议会席位决定……还是亮出锋利的刀刃？拿好手牌，决定在你手中，帝国正在等待。

tw.description:
在这款备受赞誉的策略桌游中，规划并建设一座科学管理的现代化动物园，为保护项目提供支持。

你将在《Ark Nova》中规划和设计一座科学管理的现代化动物园。并向着“拥有最成功的动物园”的终极目标努力奋斗。你将建造饲养区、容纳动物并支持世界各地的保护项目，专家们和各种独特建筑将帮助你实现这一目标。

《Ark Nova》的核心要素是 255 张以动物、专家、独特饲养区与保护项目为主题的卡牌。每张卡牌都拥有特定能力，你可以利用它们来提高动物园的魅力和科学声望并收集保护点数。每位玩家都有一组行动卡牌，你可以通过使用和升级这些卡牌来实施你的计划。

每位玩家都可以使用一套五张行动卡牌来进行游戏，行动的强度由卡牌当前占据的槽位决定。这些卡牌是：

建造：允许你建造标准/特殊饲养区、贩售亭与休憩亭。

动物：允许你在自己的动物园中容纳动物。

卡牌：允许你获得新动物园卡牌（动物、赞助商以及保护项目卡牌）。

协会：允许你的协会事务员完成不同任务。

赞助商：允许你在自己的动物园中打出一张赞助商卡牌或获得钱币。

《Ark Nova》拥有极高的可玩性和丰富的组件，可提供不同凡响的游戏体验，让玩家无数次体验游戏的乐趣。

tw.description:
在一所心理健康中心裡醒來的Robert Hill罹患了嚴重的失憶症。他需要每天遵循嚴格的作息時間，通過探索自己的夢境來找回記憶。

The White Door是一款由方塊逃脫和鏽湖系列遊戲的開發者製作的指向與點擊式冒險遊戲。

關鍵特徵:

■ 操作簡單
容易上手，但一旦玩起來就停不下來

■ 獨特的故事線
每天恪守嚴格的作息時間，探尋夢境，並找回記憶。多樣的謎題妙趣橫生，讓你意猶未盡。

■ 前所未有的分屏式體驗
你將有機會探尋Robert Hill在心理健康中心裡的經歷，而全新的分屏模式也會帶給你一個嶄新的體驗。

■ 極具代入感的氛圍

自己一人是無法探索未來與過去的！快找朋友一同拼湊線索來解開Albert Vanderboom的謎團。和朋友互相交流自己所看見的世界，來幫助彼此解開謎題、探索不同的時空！

特色

▪ 達到雙人合作的經驗

只要能與夥伴互相溝通，你們即可於各自偏好的平台一同來進行遊戲，支援的系統有：Mac、PC以及Nintendo Switch！

此遊戲含有兩個篇章，平均遊玩時間約為２小時。若想全方面體驗此款遊戲，我們非常建議可以再以不同的視角遊玩一次。 此外！可透過重複遊玩來使用嶄新的視角去解開謎團。

us.description:
The sci-fi wild west adventure in outer space continues with Space Marshals 2. This tactical top-down shooter puts you in the shoes of specialist Burton in his struggle against the criminal elements of the galaxy. 

This isn’t your ordinary dual-stick shooter. The emphasis is on tactical combat and stealth, rather than just spraying bullets, and there’s a story! 

TACTICAL COMBAT
Use the environment to your advantage. Avoid attacks by taking cover. Flank enemies for extra efficiency, but avoid getting flanked yourself! Use the tools of the trade to gain an edge - frag grenades, flash bangs, drones, gun turrets, proximity mines and much more…

STEALTH
Choose your approach carefully. Some say running into the fray, guns blazing, isn’t always the answer. Use distractions to single out opponents. Use stealth takedowns and silenced weapons to covertly reduce the enemy numbers. Hack gun turrets to turn on their masters. Lure different enemy factions together and let them fight each other.

LOAD-OUT & GEAR
Choosing your load-out is a big part of your tactics. In addition to body armor and grenades you can carry one two-handed and one single-handed weapon - and there’s something for everyone. Shotguns, handguns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, crossbows, energy weapons, throwing axes and more.

•	Tactical top-down shooter
•	Gorgeous, stylistic HD graphics rendered with Metal
•	20 missions with performance based rewards. TAMI is watching you!
•	Wide selection of weapons and gear. Over 70 different weapons.
•	Multiple factions to fight – or pitch against each other 
•	MFi controller support (requires extended layout)
•	iCloud save game support
•	Game Center achievements
•	English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano, 简体中文, 한국어, 日本語, 繁体中文, русский, Português do Brasil

Uncover a Compelling Adventure Game

But there's more to the story than meets the eye in this monster game — dark plots are brewing, and your skills will be put to the test. Explore this monster adventure game

From dense forests to mysterious caves and bustling towns, the continent of Shoru is filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Adventure through diverse environments, complete challenging quests, and uncover hidden paths to legendary treasures. Explore 2 more biomes in this sequel like the desert and find many monsters on the way of your adventure. 

Master a deep and strategic RPG battle system as a monster trainer & hunter

- Over 50 missions packed with adventure and rewards.
- Offline play—no internet required to enjoy the game.

Why Players Love EvoCreo 2:
Fans of Monster-Catching games and monster trainer RPGs will feel right at home.
A perfect mix of creature collection, exploration, and battle strategy.
Casual and hardcore gamers alike will enjoy the mix of action and adventure.

Join the adventure today and start your journey toward becoming the ultimate monster trainer in EvoCreo 2! Can you catch them all and master the secrets of the Creo?

us.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimize routes to maximize each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb toward mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the US and UK, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cozy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems
• achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them.
	Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close.

Features:

- Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells 
- Choose between loose, normal or tight setting
- Loudness boost option

FileFlip is the fastest way to convert a file on your iPhone: choose any file, and FileFlip detects what it is and shows you every format it can become. Pick one from the dropdown, tap Convert, and share or save the result. That's the whole app.

WHAT IT CONVERTS
— Images: PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, BMP and WebP → PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF or PDF
— PDFs → crisp page images (PNG or JPEG) or extracted plain text
— Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC → M4A, WAV, AIFF or CAF
— Video: MOV, MP4, M4V → MP4, MOV or audio-only M4A
— Documents: TXT, Markdown, RTF, HTML → polished PDF, TXT, RTF or HTML
— Data: CSV ↔ JSON, both directions

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every conversion runs 100% on your device using Apple's own frameworks. Your files are never uploaded anywhere — FileFlip makes no network connections at all. No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription.

BUILT-IN HISTORY
Everything you convert is kept in the History tab for one-tap re-sharing, and also appears in the Files app under On My iPhone › FileFlip, so your converted files are always yours.

Multi-page PDFs export every page as its own image. HEIC photos become shareable JPEGs in two taps. Voice memos become WAVs for editing. Camera clips become MP4s that play anywhere.

— Pay once. Own it forever.
— 100% offline. Your files never leave your phone.

Below Zero is the next chapter of Subnautica, the underwater survival open world set on an alien ocean planet.
Submerge yourself in an all-new, sub-zero expedition in an arctic region of Planet 4546B. After crash landing planetside, set out into frigid waters to investigate what happened to your sister...

Rush Rally Origins combines the classic top down racing action from the original Rush Rally with the highly praised graphics and physics from Rush Rally 3. Take on 36 new and unique stages across the world, each with the ability to change the time of day and weather. Window seat or aisle? Booth or table? Lone wolf or life of the party? In Is This Seat Taken?, your mission is to organize groups of people according to their preferences. It’s a cozy, no-pressure logic puzzle game where you’re in charge of who sits where.

Whether it’s the cinema, a crowded bus, a wedding reception, or a cramped taxi cab, every setting introduces new characters with specific tastes. A party guest with a sensitive nose won’t be happy sitting next to a stranger who’s wearing too much cologne. - Discover each character’s unique traits—relatable, outlandish, and everything in between.
- Piece together satisfying puzzles with no timers or leaderboards.
- Unlock fun new scenarios as you progress—from bus rides to banquets!

Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects in an acclaimed strategy board game.

In Ark Nova, you will plan and design a modern, scientifically managed zoo. With the ultimate goal of owning the most successful zoological establishment, you will build enclosures, accommodate animals, and support conservation projects all over the world. BUILD: Allows you to build standard or special enclosures, kiosks, and pavilions.

ANIMALS: Allows you to accommodate animals in your zoo.

CARDS: Allows you to gain new zoo cards (animals, sponsors, and conservation project cards).

ASSOCIATION: Allows your association workers to carry out different tasks.

SPONSORS: Allows you to play a sponsor card in your zoo or to raise money.

With high replayability and rich components, Ark Nova provides a remarkable gaming experience that will bring the game to the table again and again.

Adventure through diverse environments, complete challenging quests, and uncover hidden paths to legendary treasures. tr.description:
Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. 

You are bird enthusiasts—researchers, bird watchers, ornithologists, and collectors—seeking to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. Each bird extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your habitats. Each habitat focuses on a key aspect of the growth of your preserves.

In Wingspan up to 5 players compete to build up their nature preserves in a limited number of turns. Each beautiful bird that you add to your preserve makes you better at laying eggs, drawing cards, or gathering food. Many of the 170 unique birds have powers that echo real life: your hawks will hunt, your pelicans will fish, and your geese will form a flock.

Features
- Relaxing strategy card game where your goal is to discover and attract the best birds.
- Single player and multiplayer modes for up to five players.
- Based on award winning, competitive, card-driven, engine-building board game.
- Hundreds of unique, animated birds with their real life sound recordings.
- Multiple ways to accumulate points with birds, bonus cards and end-of-round goals.

tr.description:
Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them.
	Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close.

Features:

- Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells 
- Choose between loose, normal or tight setting
- Loudness boost option

FileFlip is the fastest way to convert a file on your iPhone: choose any file, and FileFlip detects what it is and shows you every format it can become. Pick one from the dropdown, tap Convert, and share or save the result. That's the whole app.

WHAT IT CONVERTS
— Images: PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, BMP and WebP → PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF or PDF
— PDFs → crisp page images (PNG or JPEG) or extracted plain text
— Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC → M4A, WAV, AIFF or CAF
— Video: MOV, MP4, M4V → MP4, MOV or audio-only M4A
— Documents: TXT, Markdown, RTF, HTML → polished PDF, TXT, RTF or HTML
— Data: CSV ↔ JSON, both directions

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every conversion runs 100% on your device using Apple's own frameworks. Your files are never uploaded anywhere — FileFlip makes no network connections at all. No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription.

BUILT-IN HISTORY
Everything you convert is kept in the History tab for one-tap re-sharing, and also appears in the Files app under On My iPhone › FileFlip, so your converted files are always yours.

Multi-page PDFs export every page as its own image. HEIC photos become shareable JPEGs in two taps. Voice memos become WAVs for editing. Camera clips become MP4s that play anywhere.

— Pay once. Own it forever.
— 100% offline. Your files never leave your phone.

*Please make sure your device is supported before purchasing Below Zero!*

Below Zero is the next chapter of Subnautica, the underwater survival open world set on an alien ocean planet.
Submerge yourself in an all-new, sub-zero expedition in an arctic region of Planet 4546B. After crash landing planetside, set out into frigid waters to investigate what happened to your sister...
Discover new biomes, creatures, challenges and story! Below Zero expands the Subnautica universe, diving deeper into the adventure and mysteries introduced in the original game.

FEATURES

UNCOVER THE TRUTH - Who were the aliens who came here before? Why were they on this planet? What really happened to your sister? And will exposing the truth give some closure to your loss?

SURVIVE THE COLD - The freezing temperatures of this arctic region pose a new challenge. Craft a toasty cold suit, sip on piping hot coffee, and warm up next to Thermal Lilies to stave off the chill.

CRAFT YOUR WAY - Survive the harsh climate by constructing extensive habitats, scavenging for resources, and crafting equipment. Blast across the snowy tundra on a Snowfox hoverbike. Cruise through enchanting and perilous biomes in your modular Seatruck.

EXPLORE THE PLANET - Swim beneath the blue-lit, arching expanses of Twisty Bridges, be mesmerized by the Crystal Caverns, venture into the icy caves of Glacial Basin or maneuver between erupting Thermal Vents to discover ancient alien artifacts.

MEET NEW CREATURES - Something undiscovered lurks around every corner. Swim through the giant Titan Holefish, encounter the haunting Shadow Leviathan, and visit the adorable Pengwings. Keep your wits about you. Not all creatures in this strange world are friendly.

tr.description:
Burgle your way to adventure in the award-winning board game!


A New Adventure Begins!
Clank!, the iconic deck-building board game adventure, challenges daring thieves to sneak into a dragon’s lair, steal one of her precious artifacts, and escape – before you’re roasted to a crisp!
Winning fans and awards around the world, Clank! is one of the most-beloved modern board games, with a wide range of expansions and adaptations for players to enjoy.

How Deep will you Delve?
The deeper you go, the more valuable treasures you’ll find…but the harder it will be to escape! So be quick and be quiet: One false step and – CLANK! Each careless sound risks drawing the dragon’s attention.
You’re competing against your fellow thieves to claim the most valuable prize…but you can only enjoy your loot if you make it out of the depths alive!


Choose Your Path
You’ll need a good pair of boots, a sharp sword, and all your roguish skills to survive in the dungeon. Along the way, you’ll acquire new items, abilities, and allies that will help you achieve victory!
Blending deck-building and exploration, Clank! offers a unique dungeon-delving adventure each time you play."


Many Ways to Play
Learn the ropes in a guided Tutorial, then hone your abilities by collecting Achievements and completing Challenges. Play cross-platform against friends, or compete in exciting new Heists that put you up against players from around the world!

However you choose to enter the dungeon: Good luck!...you’re going to need it!

Subnautica is an underwater adventure game set on an alien ocean planet. A massive, open world full of wonder and peril awaits you!

Descend into the depths, craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive. Unravel the mystery of this world teeming with creatures, both friendly and hostile, scattered with clues from a previous time.

tr.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of Dune. 

Experience the ultimate blend of strategy and intrigue as you navigate the treacherous landscapes of Arrakis in the award-winning board game Dune: Imperium!

Battle online, locally with AI, or against the formidable House Hagal.

Earn Achievements that showcase your prowess as a leader.

Embark on more than a dozen Challenges that will test your wit and cunning.

Compete for badges in the rotating Skirmish Mode where no two games are the same!

Control the Spice. Control the Universe.

Arrakis. Dune. Desert Planet. Raise your banner above the vast wasteland before you. As the Great Houses of the Landsraad marshal their forces and their spies, whom will you influence, and whom will you betray? A tyrannical Emperor. The secretive Bene Gesserit. The shrewd Spacing Guild. The ferocious Fremen of the Deep Desert. The power of the Imperium can be yours, but war is not the only way to claim it.

Dune: Imperium blends deck-building and worker placement in a deeply thematic new strategy game where the fate of the Empire hangs on your decisions. Will you seek political allies or rely upon military might? Economic strength or subtle intrigues? A council seat… or a sharpened blade? The cards are dealt. The choice is yours. The Imperium awaits.

tr.description:
Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects in an acclaimed strategy board game.

In Ark Nova, you will plan and design a modern, scientifically managed zoo. With the ultimate goal of owning the most successful zoological establishment, you will build enclosures, accommodate animals, and support conservation projects all over the world. Specialists and unique buildings will help you in achieving this goal. 

At the heart of Ark Nova are 255 cards featuring animals, specialists, unique enclosures, and conservation projects, each with a particular ability. Use them to increase the appeal and scientific reputation of your zoo and to collect conservation points. Each player has a set of action cards, which you will use and upgrade to carry out your plans.

Each player has a set of five action cards to manage their gameplay, and the power of an action is determined by the slot the card currently occupies. The cards are:

BUILD: Allows you to build standard or special enclosures, kiosks, and pavilions.

ANIMALS: Allows you to accommodate animals in your zoo.

CARDS: Allows you to gain new zoo cards (animals, sponsors, and conservation project cards).

ASSOCIATION: Allows your association workers to carry out different tasks.

SPONSORS: Allows you to play a sponsor card in your zoo or to raise money.

With high replayability and rich components, Ark Nova provides a remarkable gaming experience that will bring the game to the table again and again.

tr.description:
Sit on the throne as a benevolent (or malevolent) medieval monarch of the modern age and swipe your royal fingers either left or right to impose your will upon the kingdom. Survive the seemingly never-ending gauntlet of requests from your advisors, peasants, allies, and enemies while maintaining balance between the influential factions of your kingdom. But beware; each decision you make might have implications and unfortunate consequences down the road that could put your reign and family’s dynasty at risk!

Each year of your reign brings another important – seemingly random – request from your unpredictable kingdom as you strive for balance between the church, the people, the army, and the treasury. Prudent decisions and careful planning make for a long reign but unforeseen motivations, surprise events, and poor luck can take down even the most entrenched monarch. Extend your reign as long as possible, forge alliances, make enemies, and find new ways to die as your dynasty marches along through the ages. Some events will span on centuries, with an intrigue involving burning witches, scientific enlightenment, wicked politics and, maybe, the Devil himself.

*iPhone 5 / iPod Touch 6 / iPad Mini / iPad Air or later recommended.

The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

tr.description:
Note: The Past Within is a co-op only game. Both players need to own a copy of the game on their own device (mobile, tablet or computer), as well as a way to communicate with each other. Play together with a friend or find a partner on our official Discord server!

The past and future cannot be explored alone! Team up with a friend and piece together the mysteries surrounding Albert Vanderboom. Communicate what you see around you to help one another solve various puzzles and explore the worlds from different perspectives! 

The Past Within is the first co-op only point-and-click adventure set in the mysterious world of Rusty Lake.

Features:

▪ A co-op experience 
Play together with a friend, one in The Past, the other in The Future. Work together to solve the puzzles and help Rose set her father’s plan in motion!
▪ Two worlds - Two perspectives 
Both players will experience their environments in two different dimensions: 2D as well as in 3D - a first-time experience in the Rusty Lake universe!
▪ Cross-platform
As long as you can communicate with each other, you and your partner of choice can each play The Past Within on your preferred platform: Mac, PC and Nintendo Switch!
▪ Playtime & Replayability
The game contains 2 chapters and has an average play-time of 2 hours. For the full experience, we recommend replaying the game from the other perspective. Plus you can use our replayability feature for a fresh start with new solutions to all puzzles.

tr.description:
Descend into the Rusty Lake Underground and travel through the life and memories of Laura Vanderboom!

Travel from station to station, each metro stop symbolising a piece of Laura's past and future. Solve various puzzles, find the correct metro to board and uncover one of Laura’s timelines, while simultaneously helping her make sense of her life and escape the corruption of her mind!

Underground Blossom is a new point-and-click adventure developed by the creators of the Cube Escape & Rusty Lake series.

Features:

▪ A new experience in a familiar setting
Enjoy a classic Rusty Lake point-and-click puzzle adventure with a gripping story full of mysteries and, of course, puzzles.

▪ Expect to make several stops
Travel to 7 unique metro stations, each station a representation of Laura Vanderboom’s life, memories and potential future. The estimated travel time is 2 hours.

▪ You know what to do
Unravel the potential secrets hidden in each metro station, earn achievements and who knows what else you might stumble upon!

At each metro stop you will be greeted by an atmospheric soundtrack by Victor Butzelaar, including a cello performance by Sebastiaan van Halsema!

Swipe each card with one finger, become mayor, make bold decisions, please your people and carve your own reign into history!

Drag every card left or right; collect taxes, protect nature, grow population and keep every resource bar alive. pt.description:
Digline é um jogo de perfuração relaxante e fácil de aprender, onde cada descida é uma pequena aposta entre progresso e risco, e a verdadeira recompensa está mais fundo no subsolo.

Comece cada partida na sua oficina, escolha sua configuração e desça com combustível limitado e um equipamento improvisado. Abra caminho através de camadas de terra em constante mudança, decida o que coletar e escolha o momento certo para voltar antes que tudo se esgote.

Cada descida revela novos materiais, descobertas mais raras e padrões inesperados sob a superfície. O que começa como uma simples escavação gradualmente se transforma em um equilíbrio cuidadoso entre exploração, eficiência e tempo.

De volta à superfície, refine sua estratégia e melhore suas partidas:

• Melhore sua perfuradora, capacidade de combustível e eficiência
• Desbloqueie novos materiais de maior valor e localizados mais profundamente
• Otimize rotas para maximizar cada descida

O progresso se acumula de forma constante, mas cada partida carrega tensão. Se jogar com muita cautela, você deixa valor para trás. Se avançar demais, corre o risco de perder tudo.

Defina seu próprio ritmo no subsolo: partidas curtas e eficientes, descidas profundas de alto risco ou uma progressão constante rumo ao domínio do que está abaixo.

Top 10 jogos casuais nos Estados Unidos e no Reino Unido, Top 5 na Alemanha, Noruega e outros. Venha se juntar à diversão!

O que começa como uma simples busca por recursos gradualmente se torna algo mais estranho. Seus antigos túneis permanecem, seu mapa se expande com o tempo, e o subsolo passa a parecer menos aleatório e mais como um lugar com sua própria história.

Digline foi projetado para ser fácil de começar, divertido em sessões curtas e recompensador no longo prazo. Escavações rápidas, descidas curtas, muita diversão relaxante.

Recursos:

• controles intuitivos com um dedo em modo retrato
• partidas curtas que cabem facilmente em um ou dois minutos
• túneis persistentes e um mapa que cresce a cada expedição
• múltiplas regiões subterrâneas com diferentes materiais, perigos e surpresas
• recursos para coletar e usar na criação de melhorias e melhor preparação
• uma oficina que transforma cada partida bem-sucedida em progresso permanente
• um sistema de mercado para negociar o que você traz de volta
• progressão que se constrói ao longo de muitas sessões, não apenas uma única partida
• uma atmosfera calma e aconchegante com um senso de descoberta por baixo
• sem anúncios, sem compras dentro do aplicativo e sem sistemas pay-to-win
• conquistas e competição no placar do Daily Dig

Quanto mais fundo você vai, mais a mina revela.

pt.description:
Uma aventura de ficção científica no velho oeste espacial continua em Space Marshals 2. Este jogo de tiro tático com visão isométrica coloca o jogador na pele do especialista Burton, na luta contra os elementos criminosos da galáxia. 

Este não é um jogo de tiros qualquer. Há ênfase no combate tático com subterfúgio, além dos tiroteios. Sem contar a história! 

COMBATE TÁTICO
Use a ambientação a seu favor. Evite ataques usando coberturas. Flanqueie inimigos e evite ser flanqueado! Use as ferramentas certas para ganhar vantagens: bombas de fumaça, granadas de luz, torres de defesa, minas de proximidade e muito mais...

SUBTERFÚGIO
Escolha sua aproximação cautelosamente. Alguns dizem que entrar em combate direto, com as armas na mão, não é a melhor alternativa. Use distrações para separar inimigos. Use nocautes de subterfúgio e armas silenciosas para reduzir os números dos oponentes. Invada torres de defesa e vire-as contra seus mestres. Atraia facções diferentes para o mesmo lugar e faça-as lutar entre si.

EQUIPAMENTO E PREPARAÇÃO
Escolher seu equipamento faz parte da tática. Além da armadura e das granadas, é possível carregar uma arma de duas mãos e uma arma de uma mão. Tem para todos os gostos. Espingardas, pistolas, fuzis de assalto, fuzis de precisão, balestras, armas de energia, machados de arremesso e muito mais.
• Jogo de tiro tático com visão isométrica
• Gráficos em HD belíssimos e com estilo próprio
• 20 missões que oferecem recompensas com base no desempenho. TAMI está observando!

“An amazingly animated iOS game.” – Time Magazine

“Really can't get enough of Space Marshals.” – Touch Arcade

”Space Marshals just screams “PLAY ME!” – 148 Apps


ABOUT THE GAME
Space Marshals is a Sci-fi Wild West adventure taking place in outer space! This tactical top-down shooter puts you in the shoes of specialist Burton in his hunt for dangerous fugitives after a disastrous prison break.

TACTICAL COMBAT
Use the environment to your advantage. Avoid attacks by taking cover. Flank enemies for extra efficiency, but avoid getting flanked yourself! Use the tools of the trade to gain an edge - frag grenades, flash bangs, distractions, personal shields, proximity mines and more.

STEALTH
Choose your approach with care. Some say running into the fray guns blazing isn’t always the best option. Use distractions to single out opponents. Use disguises and covers to sneak past irrelevant guards. Use silenced weapons to covertly reduce the enemy numbers.

LOAD-OUTS & GEAR
Choosing your load-out is a big part of your tactics. In addition to body armor and grenades you can carry one two-handed and one single-handed weapon in each mission - and there’s something for everyone. Shotguns, handguns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, crossbows, energy weapons, throwing axes and more.

### IMPORTANT ### Please note that iPhone 4 is not supported.

Wingspan é um premiado jogo de cartas de estratégia relaxante sobre pássaros para 1 a 5 jogadores. Cada pássaro que você joga estende uma cadeia de combinações poderosas em um de seus três habitats.

A adaptação digital oficialmente licenciada de Wingspan, vencedora do prestigioso prêmio de jogo de tabuleiro Kennerspiel des Jahres 2019.

Vocês são entusiastas de pássaros — pesquisadores, observadores de pássaros, ornitólogos e colecionadores — procurando descobrir e atrair os melhores pássaros para sua rede de reservas de vida selvagem. Cada pássaro expande uma cadeia de combinações poderosas em um de seus habitats. Cada habitat se concentra em um aspecto fundamental do crescimento de suas reservas.

Em Wingspan, até 5 jogadores competem para construir suas reservas naturais em um número limitado de turnos. Cada pássaro lindo que você adiciona à sua reserva melhora sua capacidade de colocar ovos, tirar cartas ou colher alimentos. Muitos dos 170 pássaros únicos têm poderes que refletem na vida real: seus falcões caçam, seus pelicanos pescam e seus gansos formam um bando.

- Jogo de cartas de estratégia relaxante, onde seu objetivo é descobrir e atrair os melhores pássaros.
- Modos solo e multijogador para até cinco jogadores.
- Com base no premiado e competitivo jogo de tabuleiro baseado em cartas e construção motores.

pt.description:
MagicKit AI – Kit de Ferramentas Tudo-em-Um para o Seu Dispositivo

O MagicKit AI é um aplicativo utilitário completo, projetado para ajudá-lo a monitorar seu dispositivo, otimizar o desempenho e acessar ferramentas do dia a dia em uma interface prática. Desenvolvido especialmente para iOS, o MagicKit AI reúne funcionalidades essenciais enquanto protege sua privacidade e economiza bateria.

Ferramentas do Dispositivo e do Sistema
	•	Status da Bateria: Veja o nível de carga e o estado atual da bateria
	•	Uso de Armazenamento: Analise o espaço usado e disponível
	•	Informações do Dispositivo: Verifique detalhes do hardware e do sistema
	•	Tempo de Atividade: Monitore há quanto tempo o dispositivo está ligado
	•	Dicas de Bateria: Receba conselhos úteis para melhorar o uso da bateria
	•	Limpeza de Fotos: Detecte e remova fotos duplicadas ou semelhantes
	•	Limpeza de Contatos: Organize contatos removendo duplicatas e entradas incompletas
	•	Gerenciador de RAM: Monitore o uso da memória e otimize o desempenho
	•	Teste de Benchmark: Avalie o desempenho de CPU, GPU, memória e rede

Ferramentas de Rede
	•	Teste de Velocidade: Meça a velocidade da conexão com a internet
	•	Informações do Wi-Fi: Veja nome da rede, IP e status da conexão
	•	Consulta de IP: Verifique a geolocalização de endereços IP públicos
	•	Informações de Localização: Acompanhe GPS, velocidade, direção e altitude

Segurança e Privacidade
	•	Gerador de Senhas: Crie senhas fortes e seguras com opções personalizáveis
	•	Gerador de Frases de Acesso: Crie frases memoráveis e seguras
	•	Gerador de UUID: Crie identificadores únicos em vários formatos
	•	Gerador de PIN Seguro: Gere códigos PIN seguros com várias opções
	•	E-mail Temporário: Crie e-mails descartáveis para proteger sua privacidade

Ferramentas Utilitárias
	•	Conversor de Unidades: Converta entre diferentes unidades de medida
	•	Conversor de Moeda e Cripto: Veja taxas de câmbio em tempo real para moedas e criptomoedas
	•	Calculadora de Datas: Calcule diferenças entre datas com suporte para dias úteis
	•	Conversor de Fuso Horário: Converta horários com atualizações ao vivo e suporte a horário de verão
	•	Contagem Regressiva e Lembretes: Crie contagens regressivas personalizadas com lembretes e eventos recorrentes
	•	Contador Mágico: Acompanhe múltiplos contadores com estatísticas e sequências
	•	Leitor de QR Code: Escaneie códigos QR instantaneamente
	•	Scanner de Documentos e Cartões: Capture e salve digitalizações com reconhecimento de texto via IA
	•	Bússola e Nível: Meça direção e nível usando os sensores do dispositivo
	•	Travar Orientação: Trave a orientação da tela ao usar o app
	•	Medidor de Áudio: Meça níveis de som ao redor com o microfone
	•	Gerenciador de Área de Transferência: Acesse e gerencie textos copiados durante a sessão
	•	Lanterna e Brilho: Ative a lanterna e ajuste o brilho da tela
	•	Bloco de Notas: Crie, organize e gerencie notas com categorias e backup no iCloud
	•	Gerador Universal: Gere dados aleatórios como texto, números, datas e mais

Destaques
	•	Interface limpa e fácil de usar com ferramentas assistidas
	•	Seção de Ferramentas em Destaque com as mais populares
	•	Sem anúncios ou compras no aplicativo
	•	Leve e eficiente no uso de bateria
	•	Compatível com todos os dispositivos iOS
	•	Atualizações frequentes com novas ferramentas
	•	Desenvolvido com foco em privacidade e desempenho
	•	Suporte para tema claro/escuro com animações suaves

Perfeito para:
	•	Monitorar e otimizar o dispositivo
	•	Medições e conversões do dia a dia
	•	Escanear documentos e QR Codes
	•	Limpar fotos e contatos duplicados
	•	Criar lembretes e contagens regressivas
	•	Acompanhar hábitos e progresso
	•	Acessar ferramentas rápidas como lanterna e brilho
	•	Diagnósticos básicos de rede
	•	Criar senhas seguras e manter a privacidade
	•	Tomar notas rápidas e organizadas

Baixe o MagicKit AI hoje mesmo e simplifique suas tarefas diárias com um kit inteligente e poderoso.

pt.description:
Descubra e conquiste incontáveis ​​mundos no espaço profundo. Desvende uma história cheia de desafios e ameaças que o levarão pela galáxia em uma viagem extraordinária. 

Nada dura muito no espaço profundo, e a paz não é uma exceção!
Bem-vindo ao Iron Marines Invasion!

Aproveite missões de fase única e operações especiais em novos mundos emocionantes, cada um com seu próprio terreno, estilo, inimigos e condições particulares. Saiba como vencê-los um por um!

Comande as tropas da Federação em toda a galáxia, com a ajuda de Heróis e Unidades que levarão suas habilidades em RTS ao limite.

Lute contra inimigos extraordinários e criaturas alienígenas ferozes em missões divertidas e eletrizantes. Planeje sua estratégia para defender a paz na galáxia!

Para todos os fãs de ação de Iron Marines e SciFi que gostam de jogos RTS e estratégia geral offline. Torne-se um especialista tático, liderando seu próprio exército em missões emocionantes e alucinantes.

A invasão é iminente!
Lidere o corpo de combate mais feroz da galáxia. Lute lado a lado com os fuzileiros navais mais durões da Federação!

Agora você pode combinar seu esquadrão e aproveitar as habilidades de luta únicas de cada unidade: de guardas a franco-atiradores, mechas, lançadores de mísseis ou temíveis clãs de guerreiros alienígenas.

Treine heróis de cair o queixo e suas habilidades úteis: desde aumentar a moral e o poder de fogo do seu exército até aumentar sua resistência e alcance, ou detectar inimigos próximos antes que eles ataquem você. Ajude-os a entrar na luta para manter a paz entre os mundos!

Torne-se um especialista nos maiores mistérios da galáxia!
Use uma enciclopédia de jogo para entender os mundos que você explora ou identificar os inimigos que você enfrenta. Aproveite as informações táticas disponíveis para configurar seu plano de jogo estratégico.

Confira todos os recursos incríveis desta odisseia espacial de estratégia em tempo real:
- Uma galáxia inteira a ser descoberta.
- Mais de 25 missões de campanha que o levarão aos mundos mais incríveis. Toneladas de planetas para você explorar e defender com um plano de jogo estratégico elaborado!
- 75+ operações especiais para você atualizar suas habilidades de fuzileiros ao nível máximo.
- 10 grupos de unidades chegando a um total de 24 tropas diferentes. Você pode até combinar seus reforços dependendo da missão e estratégia que planeja mobilizar.
- 9 heróis poderosos com grandes habilidades para você treinar. Ajude-os a se tornarem os melhores da galáxia!
- 8 armas especiais para impulsionar suas táticas do exército até as estrelas! Defina seu plano de jogo e aproveite as armas instantâneas, como tribombas, bombas tóxicas ou até fábricas de drones.
- 40 atualizações para melhorar sua estratégia e capacitar suas unidades com drones de defesa, foguetes de napalm, explosões de ricochete e muito mais.
- Mais de 20 conquistas para mostrar o quanto você se tornou um especialista em estratégia em tempo real!

Escolha o seu modo de dificuldade para ter a melhor experiência de jogos RTS: casual, normal ou veterano. E para quem acha que já viu de tudo nesta galáxia... o modo impossível - apenas para os jogadores de elite, disponível offline!

Teste suas habilidades em desafios diários e colete recompensas incríveis.
Jogue RTS offline: aproveite a incrível experiência de estratégia em tempo real em qualquer lugar, enquanto explora mundos incríveis.
Iron Marines Invasion oferece horas de jogabilidade colorida e divertida nesta odisseia espacial épica de estratégia em tempo real, disponível para jogar RTS offline.

Junta-te a milhões de jogadores na sequência do jogo de monstros Pocket Monster.
Embarca numa aventura épica em EvoCreo 2, o RPG de captura de monstros no mundo de Shoru. Descobre criaturas míticas chamadas Creo, que vagam pela terra com origens e evolução misteriosas. Tens o que é necessário para desvendar os segredos dos Creo e tornar-te um lendário Monster Hunter e Evoking Master Trainer?

Descobre um jogo de aventura envolvente
Inicia a tua jornada como recruta na Academia de Polícia de Shoru. Monstros Creo estão a desaparecer, e a tua missão é descobrir a verdade por trás destes eventos misteriosos. Mas há mais nesta história do que parece – intrigas sombrias estão a formar-se, e as tuas habilidades como Monster Hunter serão desafiadas. Ajuda os cidadãos de Shoru, completando mais de 50 missões, formando alianças e descobrindo tesouros escondidos.

Captura e treina mais de 300 monstros
Adoras jogos de Monster e captura de monstros? Cria a tua equipa de sonhos com Creo neste RPG de mundo aberto. Caça monstros raros e lendários, cada um disponível em cores alternativas exclusivas. Com mais de 300 monstros únicos para capturar, evoluir e treinar, terás várias possibilidades para personalizar a tua estratégia. Cria combinações poderosas e leva os teus Creo à vitória em emocionantes batalhas por turnos como um verdadeiro Monster Hunter.

Explora este jogo de aventura
Desfruta de mais de 30 horas de jogabilidade offline e online num mundo aberto ricamente detalhado. De florestas densas a cavernas misteriosas e cidades movimentadas, o continente de Shoru está cheio de segredos. Aventura-te por diferentes ambientes, completa missões desafiantes e descobre caminhos secretos para tesouros lendários. Explora 2 novos biomas nesta sequência de jogos de monstros, como a deslumbrante Wüste, e encontra muitos monstros na tua jornada.

Domina um sistema de combate profundo e estratégico
Prepara-te para batalhas de Monster Duel com um sistema personalizável. Equipa os teus monstros com itens e desbloqueia mais de 100 características únicas. Treina os teus monstros para aprender mais de 200 movimentos, que podes trocar a qualquer momento para te adaptaste aos novos desafios. Enfrenta oponentes ferozes, gere as fraquezas elementares e utiliza as tuas habilidades táticas em batalhas por turnos. Conseguirás tornar-te um mestre dos Pocket Monsters e capturá-los todos?

Prova-te como o/a Mestre Treinador/a definitivo/a
Desafia os treinadores mais fortes de Shoru e sobe nas classificações neste RPG pago. Luta no Coliseu, onde apenas os melhores Monster Hunter Trainers serão coroados campeões. Conquistarás todas as batalhas RPG e alcançarás o título de Evoking Master Trainer, tornando-te um dos melhores jogadores neste jogo de monstros?

Características principais:
- Continuação de um dos jogos pagos mais populares do mundo
- Mais de 300 monstros colecionáveis para capturar, treinar e evoluir
- Sem limite de nível para os seus monstros - final de jogo envolvente!
- Um vasto mundo aberto com mais de 30 horas de jogabilidade offline e online

- Jogo offline – sem necessidade de internet para aproveitar o jogo
- Gráficos em pixel art, lembrando os clássicos RPGs de monstros

Por que os jogadores amam EvoCreo 2:
Fãs de jogos de Monstros vão se sentir em casa.

A mistura perfeita de coleção de monstros, exploração de mundo aberto e estratégia de batalha.
Jogadores casuais e hardcore vão adorar a combinação de ação e aventura neste RPG de monstros.
